郭松林/刘铭传/周盛波/张树声: Guo Songlin / Liu Mingchuan / Zhou Shengbo / Zhang Shusheng
洪天贵福/幼天王: Hong Tianguifu / the Young Heavenly King
朱洪章: Zhu Hongzhang; distinct from Li Hongzhang
武明良/熊登/伍维寿/张诗日: Wu Mingliang / Xiong Deng / Wu Weishou / Zhang Shiri
杨岳斌/彭玉麟/骆秉章/鲍超/冯子材: Yang Yuebin / Peng Yulin / Luo Bingzhang / Bao Chao / Feng Zicai
骑都尉/轻车都尉: hereditary dignity of cavalry commandant / light-chariot commandant; honorific hereditary ranks, not operational commands
太子少保: Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, an honorary title
贝勒: beile, imperial noble title; additional grant here, not demotion of the prince
黄马褂/双眼花翎: yellow riding jacket / two-eyed peacock feather
两种李姓: Li Hongzhang is the governor; Li Hongyi is Zeng Guofan’s secretary and the examining prefect
